summary: Independent design review approves the bounded NEW-only risk-facts command. The frozen specification fixes all twelve writable fields, whole-field replacement, unchanged omitted values, complete existing contract and DU validation, frozen/classification/Git eligibility guards, zero-write preview and rejection, and no-op preservation. It also limits interrupted replacement recovery to the same validated apply intent, preserves original audit records, and blocks stale fact materialization in strict and repairing readers. Single-writer and uncertain append-failure limitations are explicit; no general patch engine, new Schema, routing or approval change is introduced. Real scoring, automatic review arrangement, host connections, the observation window and both deferred routes remain unstarted. The specified acceptance cases cover the identified boundaries; implementation and verification remain separate evidence.
